svg.title: Recurrent-state capacity and decode graphs change short-request concurrency
svg.desc: The left panel shows the highest tested passing concurrency for the same 2K-input and 512-output workload. Lowering only the server maximum context from 262K to 8K leaves the confirmed boundary at eleven. Increasing the recurrent-state entry pool with matching decode graph batches produces passing steps at sixteen and twenty. With maximum context at 8K, the final passing concurrency is twenty-three; with maximum context at 12K, it is twenty-two. The right panel shows all three 12K C=22 p95 TTFT trials below ten seconds and the mixed C=23 trials.
